title: Not ADHD friendly
body: It’s a really complicated app for someone who has ADHD/ADD as it just gives you more things to do. You need to make sure your calendars are synced. Even though you add a new calendar block like a lunch break it does not book it on your calendar even though it says it did. It can block your energy levels on your external calendar which is the most visually anxiety providing look ever. The AI chat feature feels very outdated, it wants you to confirm everything and gives long answers for unnecessary moments which is not very ADHD friendly. The identified energy levels fo not have any explanation meaning I just do not believe in it. I think it is a great idea but needs a lot of work and is not worth to pay 60 euros a year for this version.

title: Genuinely helpful all-in-one life organiser
body:
I’ve been using Lifestack for a little while now and I’m honestly really impressed. It’s one of those rare apps that actually helps you get your life together without feeling overwhelming. The layout is clean, intuitive, and surprisingly motivating - I’ve found myself actually sticking to habits and tasks more consistently since using it.

I also really like how it combines different aspects of daily planning (goals, routines, reflections, etc.) into one place rather than having to juggle multiple apps. It feels thoughtfully designed and clearly built by people who understand how real life works. The developers are really friendly and responsive too.

If I had one small suggestion, it’d be to make customization a bit deeper — for example, more color themes or app icon options. But honestly, that’s a minor thing compared to how helpful it’s been overall.

title: Not designed for Irregular Work Hours.
body: I am a Restaurant Manager, so I work late afternoons and nights. The AI automatically slotted an exercise time while I’m at work. It slotted the one laundry to-do task I created while I’m scheduled for deep work time. The AI doesn’t seem to understand that my schedule is different and I’m awake at night and sleeping during the day. I’m canceling my subscription because y’all have more training to do for this AI, it’s not ready for irregular work hours!

title: Needs Improvement, but good premise!
body:
There are a ton of apps that claim to do what Lifestack does, but no one does it better so far! Still, though, this app is missing a lot of features, and the most glaring being that it’s missing a feature to plan your entire week. Along with a few bugs that has events overlapping. Excited to see the future of this app, but not worth the money at this point.

Especially given how expensive it is. Like wow are they upcharging. This app literally just uses Google’s Gemini and they expect you to pay 111 dollars for a lifetime sub?? Insanity.
